load_audio_from_file: load audio from a file or bytes into a CPU or CUDA buffer with optional time window filtering
load_video_from_file: load video from a file or bytes into a CPU or CUDA buffer with optional timestamp range
load_image_from_file: load an image from a file or bytes into a CPU or CUDA buffer with optional preprocessing filters
load_image_batch: batch load multiple images into a single buffer with optional resizing and pixel format conversion
save_image_to_file: save a numpy array as an image file with configurable pixel format and compression settings
